title: Porto · Douro Valley Vineyard Sweep
slogan: A 221 km loop out of Peso da Régua river
story: Terraced vineyards and river bends done slowly. This road trip is shaped as a ride, not as a shortcut: leave the start cleanly, use the first checkpoint for fuel and weather discipline, then let the middle 88 km be the part you remember. The best part sits around Peso da Régua river, Miradouro de São Leonardo, while the fuel checkpoint and Pinhão vineyards keep the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel hunt. Check the selected map before departure: scenic sections, transfer sections, speed/control reminders, risk points and the GPX checkpoint order are deliberately visible so the route is understandable before the engine starts. Ride it early if the area is popular, keep the photo stops legal, and shorten the route if weather, daylight or energy stops agreeing with the plan.

scenicChapters.title: Estrada Nacional 2
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 45 km this is Estrada Nacional 2, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
